source_review.target_clause: LVMC 11.43.010(C)(2) addresses an operator who intends a right exit from a roundabout and requires use of the right lane to turn right.
source_review.adjacent_direction_clause: LVMC 11.43.010(A) requires counterclockwise travel; the authored request follows that direction.
source_review.comparison: Use the same authored road, actor, weather, timing and same-candidate controller/camera profile; vary the circulating lane requested for the intended right exit.
source_review.interpretation_limits: The frozen witness is conditional. Do not infer intention from exit alone, assume a center lane is circulating right lane, impose a numeric right-turn threshold, or treat continuous lane holding as an independent statutory cutoff.

selection_scope: conditional CPU capture preparation only; no original Native movement, source-reviewed governed lane, pixels, legal verdict or acceptance
required_local_evidence: Native map readback of closed counterclockwise two-lane roundabout, lane adjacency and right-exit connectivity
independent pre-motion controller intention and any later intention changes
original 240-frame actor lane/road/heading/footprint and four-camera source join
human source-hashed lane and right-turn pixel review
independent original reference/contrast comparison and statutory applicability review
